description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git format-patch' command's numbering options. It sets up test cases, invokes git commands with various options, and checks the output patches for correct Subject headers indicating patch numbering behavior.

methods.name: test_num_no_numbered
methods.description: Counts the number of patches in the output by grepping for the Subject line and comparing to expected count.

methods.name: test_single_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that a patch file contains exactly one patch with no numbering.

methods.name: test_no_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the output contains exactly two patches with no numbering.

methods.name: test_single_cover_letter_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the output contains cover letter patches with numbered subjects.

methods.name: test_single_numbered
methods.description: Validates that a single patch has a numbered subject line.

methods.name: test_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that multiple patches are numbered correctly in the output.
